summary: Identified all 105 defsWithUnderscore lint violations across 24 files in Bimodal (87) and Temporal (18) namespaces. Categorized into 6 patterns: letter-prefix underscore (38), snake_case defs (13), numeric suffix (17), abbreviated prefix (13), struct fields (9), UpperCamelCase underscore (4). Plus 15 Bimodal/Temporal duplicate pairs. Created rename mapping for all 105 with camelCase targets and downstream reference counts. Highest impact: Q_Z (100 refs), U_nesting_depth (88 refs), lemma_2_7_seed (48 refs). Recommended 5-phase implementation grouped by file cluster.
